                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_isrc_total_exp,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS prev_smd_total_exp
             FROM
                     prev_business_date p
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
                                ON p.business_date = child.business_date
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact
                                ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
                                ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                     INNER JOIN radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
                                ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                                    AND UPPER(pos.PRODUCT_TYPE) <> 'NETTING'
             WHERE
                 parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                 OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                 OR EXISTS
                 (
                     SELECT 1
                     FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                     WHERE
					   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
                       and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                 )
             GROUP BY
                 child.cppib_party_id,
                 child.party_name,
                 child.rtg_final
         ),
     child_level_exp_limits AS
         (
             SELECT
                 parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
                 child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_cash_pb_exp,
                 MAX(child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.repo_fi_limit) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS der_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_fi_limit) AS der_smd_threshold,

                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
                 MAX(child.der_repo_fi_limit) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                          OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ('DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS') AND UPPER(pos.product_type) = p.product_type)
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS isrc_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.isrc_total_fi_limit) AS isrc_total_limit,
                 SUM(
                         CASE
                             WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                                  (
                                          EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                          OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 OR
                                  (
                                      EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_prod.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                                      )
                                 THEN fact.credit_exposure
                             ELSE 0
                             END
                     ) AS smd_total_exp,
                 MAX(child.smd_total_fi_limit) AS smd_total_limit
             FROM
                 radar_reporting_prod.fact_cr_exposure fact,                 
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
                 radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date = '2025-06-20' 
				 and fact.business_date = child.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
                 and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                 AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
                 AND UPPER(pos.product_type) <> 'NETTING'
                 AND
                 (
                         parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                         OR EXISTS
                                 (
                                     SELECT 1
                                     FROM radar_reporting_prod.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                     WHERE
									   parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
                                       and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                       AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                                 )
                     )               
               AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
             GROUP BY
                 parent.cppib_party_id,
                 child.cppib_party_id
         ),
     breaches_under_parents AS
         (
             SELECT
                 cppib_party_id,
                 MIN(status) AS status
             FROM
                 (
                     SELECT
                         cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
                         CASE
                             WHEN total_cash_pb_exp >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit OR total_der_repo_sbl_exp >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit OR isrc_total_exp >= isrc_total_limit OR smd_total_exp >= smd_total_limit THEN 'BREACH'
                             WHEN der_exp >= der_smd_threshold OR repo_sbl_exp >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
                             ELSE 'OK'
                             END AS status
                     FROM child_level_exp_limits
                 ) p
             GROUP BY cppib_party_id
         )
SELECT
    'Y' AS has_children,
    c.party_name,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
        WHEN SUM(der_exp) / der_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) / isrc_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) / smd_total_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
        WHEN b.status = 'BREACH'
            OR SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit
            OR SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit
            OR SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit
            OR SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit
            THEN 'BREACH'
        WHEN b.status = 'EXCESS'
            OR SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold
            OR SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold
            THEN 'EXCESS'
        ELSE 'OK'
        END AS status,
    CASE
        WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
        WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
        ELSE country_code
        END AS country_code,
    COALESCE(rtg_final, '-') AS rtg_final,
    COALESCE(rtg_outlook, '-') AS rtg_outlook,

    SUM(cash_exp) / 1000000 AS cash_exp,
    SUM(bonds_mm_exp) / 1000000 AS bonds_mm_exp,
    SUM(pb_exp) / 1000000 AS pb_exp,
    SUM(other_exp) / 1000000 AS other_exp,
    SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) / 1000000 AS total_cash_pb_exp,
    (SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) - SUM(prev_total_cash_pb_exp)) / 1000000 AS cash_pb_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_cash_pb_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_cash_pb_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_cash_pb_smd_limit = 0 OR total_cash_pb_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_cash_pb_exp)) / total_cash_pb_smd_limit * 100
        END AS cash_pb_util,

    SUM(repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((repo_sbl_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN repo_sbl_smd_threshold = 0 OR repo_sbl_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(repo_sbl_exp)) / repo_sbl_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS repo_sbl_util,

    SUM(der_exp) / 1000000 AS der_exp,
    COALESCE(der_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0 ) AS der_smd_threshold,
    CASE
        WHEN der_smd_threshold = 0 OR der_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp)) / der_smd_threshold * 100
        END AS der_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((der_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(der_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS der_available,

    SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) / 1000000 AS total_der_repo_sbl_exp,
    COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) - SUM(prev_total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / 1000000)), '-')  AS repo_der_change_exp,
    COALESCE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit / 1000000, 0) AS total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS total_der_repo_sbl_available,
    CASE
        WHEN total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit = 0 OR total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp)) / total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit * 100
        END AS repo_der_util,

    SUM(isrc_total_exp) / 1000000 AS isrc_total_exp,
    COALESCE(isrc_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS isrc_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN isrc_total_limit = 0 OR isrc_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp)) / isrc_total_limit * 100
        END AS isrc_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((isrc_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(isrc_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS isrc_total_available,

    SUM(smd_total_exp) / 1000000 AS smd_total_exp,
    COALESCE(smd_total_limit / 1000000, 0) AS smd_total_limit,
    CASE
        WHEN smd_total_limit = 0 OR smd_total_limit IS NULL THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp)) / smd_total_limit * 100
        END AS smd_util,
    REPLACE(COALESCE(format('%,.0f', truncate((smd_total_limit - GREATEST(0, SUM(smd_total_exp))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS smd_total_available,

    SUM(total_exp) / 1000000 AS total_exp,

    MAX(p.prev_rtg_final) AS prev_rtg_final,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_cash_pb_exp) >= total_cash_pb_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS cash_pb_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(repo_sbl_exp) >= repo_sbl_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(der_exp) >= der_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(total_der_repo_sbl_exp) >= total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS repo_der_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(isrc_total_exp) >= isrc_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isrc_limit_blown,
    CASE WHEN SUM(smd_total_exp) >= smd_total_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS smd_limit_blown

FROM curr_exp_total c
         LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
         LEFT JOIN prev_exp_total p
                   ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
                       OR c.party_name = p.party_name
GROUP BY
    total_cash_pb_smd_limit,
    repo_sbl_smd_threshold,
    der_smd_threshold,
    total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,
    dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
    c.party_name,
    country_code,
    rtg_final,
    rtg_outlook,
    isrc_total_limit,
    smd_total_limit,
    b.status
ORDER BY
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
        WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
        WHEN status = 'BREACH' THEN 3
        WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 4
        ELSE 5
        END,
    total_exp DESC,
    c.party_name

SELECT

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 23
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-23 20:08:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 23
		AND hour between 18 and 19
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-23 18:31:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	client_ip

with hedge_ratio_src as (
	select case
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy = 0 then f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap'
			and cast(date(dpi.maturity_date) as varchar) = dpi.business_date
			and f.abacus_notional_base_ccy != 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Equity Swap' then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy + f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy = 0 then 0
			when dpi.cppib_product_type = 'Convertible Bond'
			and f.abacus_pv_base_ccy != 0 then f.abacus_notional_base_ccy else f.abacus_pv_base_ccy
		end hedge_pv,
		coalesce((1 / fx.mid_val), 1) * coalesce(dpi.local_currency_fcp, 0) as fcp_base,
		dpi.long_short,
		h.dim_hierarchy_node_id

		join risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_risk h on h.dim_hierarchy_node_id = f.dim_hierarchy_node_id
		and dpi.business_date = h.business_date
		left join risk_prod.fact_fx_rate fx ON dpi.local_currency_iso_code = fx.to_currency
		and fx.from_currency = 'CAD'
		and fx.rate_type = 'CROSS'
		and dpi.business_date = fx.business_date
	where dpi.business_date = '2025-06-20'
		and dpi.portfolio_Type = 'IP'
		and (

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 23
		AND hour between 21 and 22
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-23 21:23:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

           LOT.brokerage_fee_amount,

           LOT.current_price,

           LOT.id_sub_trade_source,

           case
               when LOT.instrument_family_name_source = 'IRD' then
                   abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size)
               else
                   abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size) * LOT.underlying_current_price
               end
           as current_nominal,
           case
               when LOT.instrument_family_name_source = 'IRD' then
                   LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad * abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size)
               else
                   LOT.fx_rate_quoted_in_cad * abs(LOT.quantity) * abs(LOT.instrument_lot_size) * LOT.underlying_current_price
               end
           as current_nominal_pc,
           LOT.market_value + LOT.future_cash_flows  as clean_market_value,
           (LOT.market_value + LOT.future_cash_flows) * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad  as clean_market_value_pc,
           LOT.market_value                          as market_value_mv,
           LOT.market_value * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad  as market_value_base_mv,

From 	
(
  select 
    id_model_portfolio,
    id_portfolio,
    cast(id_instrument as VARCHAR) as id_instrument_new,	
    instrument_id_type,	
    id_source_holding,	
    id_enterprise_holding,
    instrument_sub_group_code,
    instrument_sub_group_name,
    instrument_type_code,	
    instrument_type_name,	
    instrument_name_source,	
    current_nominal,
    current_nominal * fx_rate_quoted_in_cad as current_nominal_pc,
    current_clean_price,	
    clean_market_value,	
    book_value,	
    cost_value,	
    current_accrued_amount,	
    fx_rate_quoted_in_cad,	
    clean_market_value_pc,	
    cost_value_pc,	
    current_accrued_amount_pc,	
    quote_factor,	
    quote_type_description,	
    next_coupon_date_source,
    '2025-06-20' as business_date,
    abor_accrued_interest_pc as abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
    abor_accrued_interest as abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
    quoted_currency_code  as current_notional_currency,
    quoted_currency_code  as market_value_currency,
    quoted_currency_code	
  FROM holdings.commercial_paper_holdings_details t
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
    and ((Instrument_sub_group_code in ('ABCP') and Instrument_type_code in ('ABCP'))
      or (Instrument_sub_group_code in ('CP') and Instrument_type_code in ('TD','BA','BD','CP','GOVTB'))
      or (Instrument_sub_group_code in ('CPPIBCPIS') and Instrument_type_code in ('CPPIBCPIS'))
      or (Instrument_sub_group_code in ('CPPIBCP') and Instrument_type_code in ('CPPIBCP'))
    )
) as a
left Join
(
  select
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
    cusip,
    isin,
    issue_date,
    document_type,
    instrument_description,
    bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    bloomberg_unique_id,
    bloomberg_exchange,
    sedol,
    ticker,
    exchange_name,
    mic,
    region_code,
    market_sector_description,
    issue_country_iso,
    coupon_rate,
    coupon_type,
    par_amount,
    issue_price,
    first_coupon_date,
    next_coupon_date,
    maturity_date,
    callable_flag,
    null as putable_flag,
    null as sinkable_flag,
    null as convertible_flag,
    null as junior_flag,
    null as senior_flag,
    null as collateral_type,
    country_code as mds_country_code,
    cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new,
    coupon_frequency_code,
    delete_date
    --coupon_frequency_unit_source
  FROM asset.asset_money_market
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'

  union all

  select
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new,
    cusip,
    isin,
    CAST(issue_date AS VARCHAR) as issue_date,
    document_type,
    instrument_description,
    bloomberg_ticker_and_exchange,
    bloomberg_unique_id,
    bloomberg_exchange,
    sedol,
    ticker,
    exchange_name,
    mic,
    region_code,
    market_sector_description,
    issue_country_iso,
    coupon_rate ,	
    coupon_type ,	
    par_amount,
    issue_price,
    first_coupon_date,
    next_coupon_date,
    maturity_date,
    callable_flag,
    putable_flag,
    sinkable_flag,
    convertible_flag,
    junior_flag,
    senior_flag,
    collateral_type,
    country_code as mds_country_code,
    cast(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new,
    coupon_frequency_code,
    cast(delete_date AS VARCHAR) as delete_date
  FROM asset.asset_bonds
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as b
  on a.id_instrument_new=b.cppib_sec_id_new
left join
(
  select
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id_new3,
    party_name, 
    bloomberg_company_id, 
    incorp_country_code,
    domicile_country_code
  FROM party.party
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as p
  on b.cppib_party_id_new=p.cppib_party_id_new3
left join	
(
  select	
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id_new2,	
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code ,	
    cppib_currency_code ,	
    cppib_currency_of_exposure_code	
  FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as c	
  on b.cppib_sec_id_new=c.cppib_sec_id_new2	
left join	
(
  select	
    country_code,	
    country_name	
  FROM reference.reference_country_codes
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as d	
  on c.cppib_country_of_exposure_code=d.country_code	
left join	
(
  select	
    currency_code,	
    currency_name	
  FROM reference.reference_currency_codes
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as e	
  on c.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code=e.currency_code	
left join
(
  select 
    model_portfolio_key,
    id_model_portfolio, 
    unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code
  FROM finance_accounting.model_portfolios
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as f
  on a.id_model_portfolio = f.id_model_portfolio
left join
(
  select 
    CAST(cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_sec_id,
    rating_value as inst_final_rating
  FROM radar_reporting_dev.cppib_security_rating
  where business_date = '2025-06-20'
    and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
) as g
  on a.id_instrument_new = g.cppib_sec_id
left join
(
  select 
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id,
    rating_value as issuer_final_rating
  FROM radar_reporting_dev.cppib_party_rating
  where cast(business_date as date) = date'2025-06-20'
    and rating_agency = 'CPPIB'
) as h
  on b.cppib_party_id_new = h.cppib_party_id
left join
(
  select 
    CAST(cppib_party_id AS VARCHAR) as cppib_party_id,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
     cppib_sector_classification_name_4
  FROM party.party_enterprise_classification
  where business_date = date'2025-06-20'
) as i
  on b.cppib_party_id_new = i.cppib_party_id

SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl

	left join

			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )

		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

SELECT
	from_currency
	,to_currency
	,mid_price
	,business_date
	,inverse_quoted
FROM
(
	SELECT
		from_currency
		,to_currency
		,CASE
			WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
			ELSE mid_price
		END as mid_price
		,business_date
		,'N' as inverse_quoted
	FROM
		"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
	WHERE
		(
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CAD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
		)
		OR
			(rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='GBP'
			AND to_currency IN ('EUR'))
		)
	UNION ALL
	SELECT
		t_usdrates.to_currency as from_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.to_currency
		,t_usdcadrate.mid_price/t_usdrates.mid_price as mid_price
		,t_usdcadrate.business_date
		,t_usdcadrate.inverse_quoted
	FROM
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code = 'SR'
			AND from_currency = 'USD'
			AND to_currency = 'CAD'
	) t_usdcadrate
	INNER JOIN
	(
		SELECT
			from_currency
			,to_currency
			,CASE
				WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1/mid_price
				ELSE mid_price
			END as mid_price
			,business_date
			,'N' as inverse_quoted
		FROM
			"market"."refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr"
		WHERE
			rate_type_code ='SR'
			AND from_currency ='USD'
			AND to_currency IN ('AED','ARS','AUD','BMD','BRL','BSD','CHF','CLP','CNH','CNY','COP','CZK','DKK','EGP','EUR','GBP','GHS','HKD','HRK','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','JPY','KRW','KYD','MAD','MXN','MYR','NGN','NOK','NZD','PAB','PEN','PHP','PLN','RON','RUB','SEK','SGD','THB','TRY','TWD','UAH','VND','ZAR')
	) t_usdrates
	ON t_usdrates.business_date = t_usdcadrate.business_date
	AND t_usdrates.from_currency = t_usdcadrate.from_currency
) t_rates

	asi.incorp_country_code, 
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,

	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id

	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code

	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)

SELECT * FROM (WITH params AS (
        SELECT from_iso8601_date( NULL ) AS query_date
    ),
	adjusted_date AS (
		SELECT
			query_date,
			CASE
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 1 THEN query_date - interval '3' day
				WHEN day_of_week(query_date) = 7 THEN query_date - interval '1' day
				ELSE query_date - interval '1' day
				END AS business_date
		FROM params
	),
     account_mapping_query AS (
         SELECT
             date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
             pam.mx_portfolio_id AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
             pam.bbg_pfolio_id AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
             pam.model_portfolio AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
             pam.sst_account AS SST_ACCOUNT
         FROM reference.model_portfolio_account_mapping pam
                  JOIN adjusted_date ad ON pam.as_of_date = ad.business_date
             )
        SELECT
            COALESCE(BUSINESS_DATE, '') as BUSINESS_DATE,
            COALESCE(TRIM(MUREX_PORTOFOLIO), '') as MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            COALESCE(TRIM(BBG_ACCOUNT), '') as BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SCD_ACCOUNT), '') as SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(SST_ACCOUNT), '') as SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM account_mapping_query
        UNION
        SELECT
            date_format(ad.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS BUSINESS_DATE,
            '' AS MUREX_PORTOFOLIO,
            '' AS BBG_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '') AS SCD_ACCOUNT,
            COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '') AS SST_ACCOUNT
        FROM reference.scd_model_portfolio scd
                 JOIN adjusted_date ad ON CAST(scd.business_date AS DATE) = ad.business_date
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM account_mapping_query fq
            WHERE COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SCD_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.model_portfolio_id), '')
              AND COALESCE(TRIM(fq.SST_ACCOUNT), '') = COALESCE(TRIM(scd.sst_custody_account_code), '')
        )) T LIMIT 0

        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_securities) AS max_scds_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM reference.scd_party_issuer) AS max_spi_bd,
        (SELECT MAX(business_date) FROM cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite) AS max_epc_bd
        
)

    psl.business_date,
	ist.investmentstructurelevel1 as investment_structure_level_01,

	(

			ex.exchange_symbol as exchange_symbol2, 
			ex2.exchange_name, 
			ct.tickersymbol,
			ct.primaryflag, 
			ex2.exchange_symbol, 
			fd.periodtypeid, 
			fd.fiscalquarter, 
			c.companyname, 
			mc.companyid, 
			mc.pricingdate,
			mc.marketcap, 
			mc.tev as totalenterprisevalue, 
			mc.sharesoutstanding,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4192 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebtoverebitda,
			case 
				when fd.dataitemid = 4173 then fd.dataitemvalue 
				else null end as totaldebt,
			fd.calendaryear, 
			fd.calendarquarter, 
			fd.fiscalyear
		from party.capiq_company c
		join (
			select
				fp.companyid, fp.periodtypeid, fp.fiscalquarter, fp.calendaryear, fp.calendarquarter, fp.fiscalyear,
				ic.financialinstanceid, fd.dataitemvalue, fd.financialcollectionid, fd.dataitemid,
				rank() over (partition by fp.companyid, fd.dataitemid order by fi.filingdate desc) rank
		    from party.capiq_ciqfinperiod fp 
    		join party.capiq_ciqfininstance fi 
			    on fi.financialperiodid = fp.financialperiodid
			join party.capiq_ciqfininstancetocollection ic 
			    on ic.financialinstanceid = fi.financialinstanceid 
			join party.capiq_ciqfincollectiondata fd

			where
			    fp.periodtypeid = 4 		
			    and fp.latestperiodflag = 1

		where

/* cppi::8b9074e778c70f32dd4d41c9b5c7fdceba65bd71e82742c7d33f0c2a65ca6f54 */
/* QuickSight */
SELECT ds.* FROM ( WITH
    listed_ra_mp AS (
        SELECT business_date,
               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name,
            InvestmentStructureLevel5
        FROM performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
        WHERE model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%DO NOT USE%'
          AND model_portfolio_name NOT LIKE '%Corporate Expenses%'
          AND InvestmentStructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
          AND InvestmentStructureLevel2 = 'Real Assets'
          AND (
                InvestmentStructureLevel3 IN ('Infrastructure','Real Estate','Sustainable Energy Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel4 IN ('Dev Mkts - Infrastructure', 'Emerging Mkts - Infrastructure','Listed Real Estate','Power and Renewables Group')
                  AND InvestmentStructureLevel5 IN ('Listed Infrastructure - DM', 'Listed Infrastructure - EM','Listed Real Estate DM', 'Listed Real Estate EM','Power Generation')
                  AND model_portfolio NOT IN ('RIRELCP')
                   OR model_portfolio IN ('MIN1000104','MPRSBE0', 'MPR1000279', 'MPR1000328', 'MPR1000200', 'MPAR100041')
                )
          AND CAST(business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_trans AS (
        SELECT trans.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY trans.abor_security_number, trans.scd_transaction_number_primary_key
                    ORDER BY trans.changed_date DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM trades_deals.scd_transactions trans
        WHERE trans.transaction_cancellation_flag = 'Active'
        --  AND trans.requested_transaction_status = 'Final GL'
          AND trans.reconciliation_status = 'Reconcilable'
          AND trans.business_transaction_code in ('Sell','CASell','SellInternal','Buy','CABuy','BuyInternal','CapRed','Exchange Offer','Dividend','Rights Distribution','GenCost')
          AND CAST(trans.trade_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
    ),
    latest_finance_trans AS (
        SELECT fin.*, 
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY fin.scd_finance_transaction_number_primary_key, fin.finance_transaction_index
                    ORDER BY fin.extract_time DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM finance_accounting.scd_finance_transactions fin
        WHERE fin.finance_scheme LIKE '%EQTY%'
          AND fin.accounting_framework_id = 'MAIN'
          AND fin.gl_account_name != 'CASH BALANCE'
          AND fin.gl_account_name NOT LIKE '%DUE%'
          AND fin.booking_type != 'Payment reconciliation'
    ),
    trans AS (
        SELECT
            trans.trade_date                        AS business_date,
            trans.model_portfolio_id                AS model_portfolio_id,
            sec.bloomberg_unique_id                 AS bb_unique_id,
            CASE
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Sell ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Sell Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Sell','SellInternal','CASell') AND fin.gl_account_name LIKE '%REALIZED%' THEN 'Sell GL'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy','Exchange Offer') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'Net Purchase'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Buy','BuyInternal','CABuy') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TRNS BRKR COMM COST%' THEN 'Purchase Costs'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%DIVIDEND INC%' THEN 'Gross Dividend'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('Dividend') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%TAX EXP%' THEN 'Dividend Taxes'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%COST OF INVESTMENT%' THEN 'CapRd ROC'
                WHEN trans.business_transaction_code IN ('CapRed') AND fin.gl_account_name  LIKE '%REALIZED CURR GL%' THEN 'CapRd GL'
                ELSE 'unmapped'
            END                                     AS transaction_type,            
            fin.credit_amount_portfolio_currency-fin.debit_amount_portfolio_currency     AS total_amount_pc,
            fin.credit_amount_quotation_currency-fin.debit_amount_quotation_currency     AS total_amount_qc
            FROM latest_trans trans

            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'Purchase Costs' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_cost_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd ROC' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_roc_pc,
            SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'CapRd GL' THEN total_amount_pc ELSE 0 END) AS cap_gl_pc
        FROM trans 
        WHERE transaction_type != 'unmapped'
        GROUP BY business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id     
    ),
    calculated_trans AS(
        SELECT business_date, bb_unique_id,model_portfolio_id,
            net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc AS gross_purchase_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc AS net_sell_pc,
            cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS total_cap_pc,
            sell_roc_pc + sell_cos_pc + sell_gl_pc + net_purchase_pc + purchase_cost_pc + cap_roc_pc + cap_gl_pc AS net_cap_bal_pc
        FROM aggregated_trans
    ),
    performance AS(
        SELECT business_date,
            model_portfolio_id,
            abor_security_id,
            cash_flow_reporting_currency,
            cash_flow_quotation_currency,
            clean_price,
            payments_quotation_currency,
            payments_reporting_currency,
            reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
            reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
            nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day
        FROM performance.scd_performance_calculation
    )

SELECT
    CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)                                              AS "Business Date",
    regional_classification_name                                                     AS "DM/EM",
    sec_ent.cppib_sector_classification_name_4                                       AS "Sector",
    holding.abor_security_id                                                         AS "Ticker",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Share Owned",
    holding.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency                                    AS "Cost QC",
    holding.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency                                    AS "Cost PC",  
    holding.unrealised_pnl_book_value_quotation_currency                             AS "ITD Unrealized PnL QC",                                    
    sec.bloomberg_unique_id                                                          AS "BB Unique ID - Current",
    TRIM(REPLACE(sec.bloomberg_cd, sec.sec_typ_lvl1_nm, ''))                         AS "Bloomberg Code - Current",
    mp.model_portfolio_name                                                          AS "Model Portfolio Name",
    mp.model_portfolio_id                                                            AS "Model Portfolio Code",
    sec.sec_nm                                                                       AS "Security Name - Current",
    holding.quotation_currency_code                                                  AS "Quoted Currency",
    country.country_name                                                             AS "Country of Exposure Name - Current",
    holding.balance_nominal_number                                                   AS "Balance Nominal/Number",
    holding.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value QC",
    holding.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency                                     AS "Total Market Value PC",
    perf.clean_price                                                                 AS "Clean Price",
    perf.nominal_value_buy_sell_during_the_day                                       AS "Size",
    perf.cash_flow_reporting_currency                                                AS "Cash Flow PC",
    perf.cash_flow_quotation_currency                                                AS "Cash Flow QC",
    perf.payments_quotation_currency,
    perf.payments_reporting_currency,
    perf.reallocation_payments_quotation_currency,
    perf.reallocation_payments_reporting_currency,
    calc.gross_purchase_pc AS "Gross Purchase PC",
    calc.net_sell_pc AS "Net Sell PC",
    calc.total_cap_pc AS "Total Capital PC",
    COALESCE(calc.net_cap_bal_pc,0) AS "Net Capital Balance PC"
FROM holdings.scd_holdings_main holding
INNER JOIN listed_ra_mp invstr
        ON holding.model_portfolio_id = invstr.model_portfolio
       AND holding.business_date = invstr.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.scd_model_portfolio mp
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = mp.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.business_date = mp.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_identifiers sec
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec.business_date
LEFT JOIN asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications sec_ent
       ON holding.cppib_sec_id = CAST(sec_ent.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = sec_ent.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_currency_codes currency1
       ON holding.quotation_currency_code = currency1.currency_code
      AND CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) = currency1.business_date
LEFT JOIN reference.reference_country_codes country
       ON sec_ent.cppib_country_of_exposure_code = country.country_code
      AND country.business_date = CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE)
LEFT JOIN calculated_trans calc
       ON calc.bb_unique_id = sec.bloomberg_unique_id 
      AND calc.business_date = holding.business_date
      AND calc.model_portfolio_id = holding.model_portfolio_id
LEFT JOIN performance perf
       ON holding.model_portfolio_id = perf.model_portfolio_id
      AND holding.abor_security_id = perf.abor_security_id
      AND holding.business_date = perf.business_date
WHERE CAST(holding.business_date AS DATE) >= DATE('2024-04-01')
  AND holding.cppib_sec_id IS NOT NULL
  AND holding.abor_security_type_name IN ('Common Stock', 'Depository Receipt', 'PMI Deferred Tax Liability', 'Preferred Stock', 'REIT', 'Unit', 'Right')
ORDER BY holding.business_date DESC,
         sec.bloomberg_unique_id ) ds LIMIT 0

select *, reduce(dv01, 0 , (s, x) -> s + x, s -> s) AS total from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_active_risk_dv01
where business_date = '2025-06-20' 
) group by benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, run_id
) as e on var.run_id = e.run_id and e.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and e.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and e.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node
left join 
(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, node_level, pv, run_id from
radar_reporting_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv 
where business_date = '2025-06-20'
) as f on var.run_id = f.run_id and f.benchmark_name = var.benchmark_name 
and f.hierarchy_type = var.hierarchy_type and f.hierarchy_node = var.hierarchy_node 
and f.node_level = 1

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance_dev.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"

			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'

		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'

		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

			union all

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency

		from
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[

			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency

			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'

			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'

			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'

		  end period

			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
